rules.title: Required form accompanying notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.requirement: A landlord's written notice to quit a residential tenant for nonpayment of rent must include a state-developed form with any repayment agreements, information on rental assistance, court rules and eviction restrictions, and a prominent statement that the notice is not an eviction. Courts may not accept a nonpayment eviction filing without proof that the form was delivered.
rules.key_value: Notice to quit for nonpayment must include EOHLC form; no court filing without proof of delivery
rules.quoted_span: No court having jurisdiction over an action for summary process pursuant to chapter 239, including the Boston municipal court department, shall, in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit, accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint without proof of delivery of the form required under this section.
rules.coverage_text: Notices to quit for nonpayment of rent given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant
rules.penalty: Court will not accept for filing a summary process writ, summons or complaint for nonpayment without proof of delivery of the form.
rules.extraction_note: This is an eviction notice-content requirement rather than a just-cause limitation on permitted eviction grounds; classified under just_cause_eviction because the category covers notice. Effective and enactment dates not stated in the document. The executive office of housing and livable communities develops the form; clause (ii) information must be available in English plus the 5 most common languages in the commonwealth.
